hypothesis.claim: The fully frozen FOSSIL-MATCH transition can recover useful exact continuations more than 16,777,216 transformed bytes old that FXCM's ring reads alias, expose at least 254,953 active bytes, beat every matched control in each chronological third and at least two distance buckets, and remain inside composite-aware resource bounds.
hypothesis.falsification: Retire this exact transition without a parameter rescue if either full scan differs, fewer than 254,953 treatment bytes activate, any chronological third fails D_correct greater than max(S,R,N)_correct, fewer than two distance buckets pass that margin, causal or exact verification fails, or process-tree, cgroup, event, cache, or scratch bounds fail.

changedMechanism: Correction-only closure of v1: retain exact far-history as the sole information source while freezing all transition constants, strengthening matched-control transfer, and accounting for file cache through cgroup-v2 and later native composite replay.
invariants: The scanner consumes the exact 587,138,826-byte transformed-ready population with SHA-256 7826ff63dedd526c119dda08e6e044be8fa8f6e89a55f3d6b1f3447cdfc5c1ce.
The 16-byte polynomial hash uses base 0x9e3779b185ebca87, base^16 0x6fe6ef9fbd3b9581, and unsigned modulo-2^64 arithmetic exactly as frozen in the v2 design.
The table has exactly 2^24 records of uint32 tag=H>>32 and uint32 continuation_plus_one; index H&0x00ffffff; zero continuation is the only empty sentinel.
Every nonsequential transformed-input read passes PastByte(index,i), which aborts unless index is strictly below current position i.
A lookup compares all 16 historical context bytes in increasing order before activation and requires i-c greater than 16,777,216.
There is no persistent continuation state: every position performs a fresh table lookup and exact context verification.
D, S, R, and N are constructed from state through i-1 and scored before x_i changes the table, ring, or rolling hash.
After scoring every i at least 16, replacement unconditionally writes tag H>>32 and continuation_plus_one i+1 to the selected slot.
S reads ring[c&0x00ffffff] before the current truth updates ring[i&0x00ffffff]; R and N use the exact frozen formulas.
K performs the identical causal input traversal and every state transition while emitting no prediction.
Control outcomes never alter treatment activation, replacement, hashing, counters used for state, or later treatment state.
Standalone shadow evidence has zero arithmetic-archive and objective authority; native parent-plus-specialist resource and archive replays remain mandatory.
The 254,953 threshold is active-byte count times an impossible 16-byte-per-active-byte leverage ceiling, not measured or forecast savings.

controls.definition: Predict history[c] after the frozen table lookup, exact 16-byte context verification, and strict greater-than-16-MiB distance check.
Execute the exact same input, hash, table, verification, ring, replacement, counters, and state digests with prediction disabled.
At each D-active position, predict ring[c&0x00ffffff] before current-truth insertion, reproducing the parent ring alias for the same absolute continuation.
At each D-active position, predict the high byte of SplitMix64(H xor (uint64(i)<<1) xor 0xd1b54a32d192ed03).
At each D-active position, predict D xor 0xff.
A fresh second process reproduces normalized receipts, all counters, thirds, buckets, table digests, and opportunity digests exactly.

population.coordinate: Zero-based transformed byte offset before native CMIX arithmetic coding.
